thread.text: You charged me twice for September (89€ on the 3rd and again on the 4th). I also cannot export invoices since the 18th — the button spins then 500s. If this is not refunded and the export fixed before Friday I am cancelling.
We see two successful charges on the same invoice INV-2091. Export errors are tracked as INC-441.

route.instructions: Which team should own the next reply?

criteria.billing: Duplicate charge, refund, invoice, or payment dispute
criteria.technical: Product bug, outage, or export failure
criteria.mixed: Billing and product failure in the same thread, needs a joint owner

severity.instructions: How severe is this for the customer right now?
criteria: Noise, no money or access impact
Money or core feature blocked, deadline named
Churn or legal exposure this week

churn_risk.instructions: Will this customer cancel within 7 days if nothing is fixed?

refund_due.instructions: Is a refund of the duplicate 89€ charge clearly due?

next_action.instructions: What should the agent do first?

criteria.refund_now: Refund the duplicate charge before anything else
criteria.reply_eta: Send a holding reply with an ETA and no action yet
criteria.save_offer: Offer a credit or pause to stop the cancellation
